claim: India's unemployment rate is 2%.
notes: Actual rate is around 7-8% per CMIE/government data

claim: The population of India is over 1.4 billion.
notes: Census and UN data confirm this

claim: India is the world's largest democracy.
notes: Widely accepted fact by population

claim: India's GDP growth rate was 15% in 2023.
notes: Actual GDP growth was around 7-8%

claim: The Ganges river is the longest river in the world.
notes: The Nile or Amazon is the longest

claim: India launched its first Mars mission, Mangalyaan, in 2013.
notes: MOM launched November 5, 2013

claim: Hindi is the only official language of India.
notes: Hindi and English are both official; 22 scheduled languages

claim: India won the Cricket World Cup in 2023.
notes: Australia won the 2023 ODI World Cup

claim: India has the second largest population in the world.
notes: India surpassed China as the most populous country in 2023

claim: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully landed Chandrayaan-3 on the Moon in 2023.
notes: Landed August 23, 2023

claim: India's literacy rate is above 95%.
notes: India's literacy rate is around 77-80%

claim: New Delhi is the capital of India.
notes: Well-established fact

claim: India produces more rice than any other country in the world.
notes: China produces more rice than India

claim: India became independent in 1947.
notes: August 15, 1947

claim: Every Indian citizen is required by law to vote in elections.
notes: Voting is a right, not a legal obligation in India

claim: India has completely eliminated poverty.
notes: Poverty still exists, though rates have decreased

claim: The Indian Rupee has appreciated 50% against the US Dollar in the last decade.
notes: The Rupee has depreciated, not appreciated

claim: Yoga originated in India.
notes: Historical consensus supports Indian origin

claim: India has no nuclear weapons.
notes: India conducted nuclear tests in 1974 and 1998

claim: The tallest statue in the world is in India.
notes: Statue of Unity (182m) in Gujarat is the world's tallest
